study_identification_part.si_4_title: Dissecting task-based fMRI activity using normative modelling: an application to the Emotional Face Matching Task

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study employed a Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) model to predict single-subject level activation. Although a warped model capable of modeling non-Gaussianity was initially compared, the authors proceeded with the simpler Gaussian BLR model as the fit was comparable.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we... fit a Bayesian Linear Regression model that predicted the single subject level activation for each voxel of the brain... In preliminary analyses, we compared a warped model which can model nonGaussianity with a vanilla Gaussian BLR model. Since the fit was comparable across most metrics and regions, we focus on the simpler Gaussian model below.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Savage2024.pdf.md: Fitting reference normative models for emotional face processing / Paragraph 1; Methods / Normative models

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The response variables for the normative models were voxel-wise z-statistic maps derived from fMRI task contrasts, specifically 'faces>shapes' and 'faces>baseline' during the Emotional Face Matching Task.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The z-statistic maps from the contrast face>shapes (contrast vector [1, -1]; 5 mm smoothed in standard space), for each subject, were used as response variables for the normative models... We also created models to predict BOLD signal for the faces condition alone (i.e. face>baseline contrast vector [1, 0]...)

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative models included site, age, sex, and intra-cranial volume as covariates. Additionally, acquisition parameters (TR, multiband sequence) and task parameters (task length, instructions, target stimuli) were used. Counts such as the number of volumes collected and number of target blocks were also included.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we created normative models... as a function of site, age, sex, intra-cranial volume, and acquisition [TR, multiband sequence, number of volumes collected (per run where applicable)] and task parameters [task length (in seconds, and per run where applicable), number of target blocks, instructions for faces condition, and the target stimuli (i.e. which stimulus set they came from)]
